covariate_notes.duration: charted anaesthesia duration in minutes; taken from anestart and aneend in a case row, or passed as duration=; without a usable one the latent is the marginal over fitted cases (flag duration_marginal)
covariate_notes.department: shifts the heaping propensities (100 / 50 / 10 mL grids); without it, or for another department, propensities are averaged over the fitted department shares (flag department_marginal)

intraop_uo.zero_rule: A recorded 0 is a point mass at 0 mixed with the latent below 2.5 mL (zero_model in the model file); flag zero_anuric (preop_cr > 2 or asa == 6) or zero_unexplained. Missing means not measured, not 0.
intraop_uo.anchor_note: Nearest rounding preferred to floor (H1, last graduation passed) by BIC: 383 with the duration covariate, 317 without (same 3630 records; results/2026-10-18_refits_duration_zero.md).
